scope: Independent structural/causal challenge of fresh material deltas already in downstream T0 backlog; no ordinary expansion under backpressure.
summary: Fresh deltas do not justify new structural gates for VRT, CRDO or NVDA. RKLB financing changes resilience and capital structure but does not remove acquisition/integration/regulatory dependence; dilution normalization remains the exact reproducibility gate owned outside Beta. Structural claims preserve counterfactuals and avoid converting announced capacity, product availability or issuer accretion expectations into realized causal outcomes.

claims: Completed ATM financing reduces the near-term bridge-funding bottleneck for the Iridium transaction but substitutes a shareholder-dilution cost and future integration/guarantee exposure.

The structural thesis remains conditional on regulatory close and successful integration; financing sufficiency is not evidence that acquisition synergies or durable competitive advantage are realized.
causalEdges: share issuance -> dilution -> per-share outcome pressure
falsifiers: Regulatory failure or transaction termination would break the acquisition-derived structural edge.
Post-close integration underperformance would falsify synergy-based resilience claims.
contradictions: Funding resilience improved while per-share dilution worsened; neither side cancels the other.
evidence.exactGate: Current post-ATM share-count normalization is required for reproducible per-share methodology treatment; structural evidence itself is sufficient.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Rocket Lab SEC 8-K/424B/next 10-Q equity and shares-outstanding disclosure after the completed ATM.

claims: UIG can strengthen Vertiv's time-to-power position only if acquired capabilities actually shorten utility/interconnection deployment constraints; acquisition announcement alone does not prove bottleneck relief.
Contingent consideration aligns part of purchase economics with future EBITDA but increases capital-allocation exposure if expected integration benefits fail.
causalEdges: UIG capabilities -> potential time-to-power reduction -> data-center deployment throughput
falsifiers: No measurable reduction in project cycle time or cross-sell after integration would weaken the claimed bottleneck edge.

claims: 224G/lane 1.6T optical capability is structurally relevant to AI-network bandwidth pressure, but product availability does not establish durable share, customer adoption or margin capture.
Vertical integration of DSP, silicon photonics and diagnostics may reduce interface/dependency friction, subject to production execution.
causalEdges: AI bandwidth demand -> higher-speed interconnect need -> 1.6T opportunity
integrated optical stack -> potential reliability/diagnostic advantage
falsifiers: Failure to achieve production adoption or competitive performance would break the product-to-bottleneck-capture edge.

claims: Partner-operated Australian capacity can expand the addressable deployment surface for NVIDIA compute/networking/software, but the 2 GW figure is an ecosystem infrastructure target rather than NVIDIA-owned capacity or contracted revenue.
The causal edge depends on partner financing, power/interconnection execution and actual NVIDIA system deployment.
causalEdges: partner power/data-center build -> deployable AI capacity -> potential NVIDIA platform demand
falsifiers: Partner build delays, financing failure or non-NVIDIA deployment would weaken conversion from announced capacity to NVIDIA economic benefit.

blockingIssues.gate: Post-ATM share-count normalization for reproducible per-share treatment
